parameters.query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS finance_invoices (
  id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
  invoice_number VARCHAR(100) UNIQUE NOT NULL,
  issue_date DATE,
  tax_code VARCHAR(50),
  seller_name VARCHAR(255),
  buyer_name VARCHAR(255),
  buyer_email VARCHAR(255),
  subtotal NUMERIC(15, 2),
  vat_amount NUMERIC(15, 2),
  total_amount NUMERIC(15, 2),
  storage_path TEXT,
  status VARCHAR(50) DEFAULT 'VALID',
  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);

INSERT INTO finance_invoices (invoice_number, issue_date, tax_code, seller_name, buyer_name, buyer_email, subtotal, vat_amount, total_amount, storage_path, status)
VALUES (
  '{{ $json.invoice_number }}',
  '{{$json.issue_date }}',
  '{{ $json.tax_code }}',
  '{{$json.seller_name }}',
  '{{ $json.buyer_name }}',
  '{{$json.sender_email }}',
  {{ $json.subtotal }},
  {{$json.vat_amount }},
  {{ $json.total_amount }},
  '{{$json.storage_path }}',
  'VALID'
)
ON CONFLICT (invoice_number) DO UPDATE 
SET total_amount = EXCLUDED.total_amount,
    status = 'VALID'
RETURNING *;
